title: Non-Abelian quantum Hall states at strong Landau level mixing: finding anyons with first-principles AI
abstract: arXiv:2610.18967v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Non-Abelian anyons, strange particles forming the basis of fault-tolerant topological quantum computing, are predicted to emerge in fractional quantum Hall states at even-denominator filling factors. Identifying which topological order is realized has proven to be a challenging problem that requires an accurate, non-perturbative treatment of realistic Landau level mixing, which has so far been missing from theoretical studies. Here we present the first complete solution of non-Abelian quantum Hall problem that includes all electrons and all Landau levels, for spin-polarized electrons at filling factor $\nu = 3/2$. We develop a momentum-resolved neural-network variational wave function, optimized solely on the microscopic Hamiltonian, which gives direct access to the topologically degenerate ground states. translated_title: 强朗道能级混合下的非阿贝尔量子霍尔态：用第一性原理人工智能寻找任意子
translated_abstract: 非阿贝尔任意子——作为容错拓扑量子计算基础的奇特粒子——被预测出现在分母为偶数填充因子的分数量子霍尔态中。确定实现的是何种拓扑序一直是一个具有挑战性的问题，这需要对真实的朗道能级混合进行精确的非微扰处理，而迄今为止的理论研究一直缺乏这一处理。在本工作中，我们首次完整求解了非阿贝尔量子霍尔问题，涵盖了全部电子和所有朗道能级，研究对象为填充因子 ν = 3/2 的自旋极化电子。我们开发了一种动量分辨的神经网络变分波函数，仅基于微观哈密顿量进行优化，从而能够直接获取拓扑简并的基态。在没有任何关于预期结果的物理先验输入的情况下，该方法发现了一个简并基态流形，其纠缠……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究首次完整求解了包含全部电子与所有朗道能级的非阿贝尔量子霍尔问题，通过仅由微观哈密顿量优化、无任何先验物理输入的动量分辨神经网络变分波函数，在 ν=3/2 的自旋极化电子体系中发现了非阿贝尔任意子所对应的拓扑简并基态流形。
en_tdlr: This work presents the first complete solution of the non-Abelian quantum Hall problem including all electrons and all Landau levels, using a momentum-resolved neural-network variational wave function optimized solely from the microscopic Hamiltonian, which—without any prior physical input—discovers a topologically degenerate ground-state manifold indicative of non-Abelian anyons at ν=3/2.
